title: Anthropic launches Live Artifacts for real-time dashboard #anthropic #LiveArtifacts #productivity
description: Anthropic launched Live Artifacts, a new feature in Claude that enables real-time dashboards fully integrated with live data. Unlike previous static snapshots, these dashboards auto-update every time they’re opened, maintaining accuracy without manual refreshes. Live Artifacts allows users to create dynamic sales trackers, KPI boards, project boards, and business dashboards all within one Claude chat. This innovation reduces reliance on outdated spreadsheets and streamlines data management, improving productivity and data-driven decision-making. By embedding live data into AI-driven dashboards, Anthropic enhances workflow automation and offers scalable insights for businesses seeking continuous monitoring and real-time reporting. This technology represents a significant step forward in AI-assisted data visualization and operational efficiency. #Anthropic #ClaudeAI #LiveArtifacts #AIDashboards #BusinessIntelligence #KPITracking #SalesTracking #ProjectManagement #AIAutomation #DataVisualization #RealTimeData #ProductivityTools #AIInnovation #WorkplaceTech #ChatbotIntegration
